name: avunu/cwicly-test-tools
description: Test runners for the cwicly maintenance fork. Deliberately separate from the plugin's own composer.json: composition-c4's fetchComposerDeps clones lock.packages ++ lock.packages-dev at eval time with allRefs=true, so anything added to the root manifest is paid for on every `nix build .#zip`. Static analysers are NOT here either -- phpstan comes from nixpkgs.
